visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses, a Santa hat, and a red Santa suit with white fur trim and a black belt stands centered against a light blue wall. He speaks to the camera, using his hands for emphasis while a small black lapel microphone is visible on his white shirt. High-level text is positioned at the top of the frame. (2) The scene cuts to a bedroom setting where the man begins dancing rhythmically. A wooden bed frame with light-colored pillows is visible in the background. The lighting is bright and even. Subtitles in both English and Mandarin appear at the bottom of the screen as he moves his torso and arms. (3) The man continues his dance but now reaches down to pick up several bright red envelopes. He waves them enthusiastically towards the camera. The background environment remains the same, showing the interior of the bedroom. The man's facial expressions are energetic and focused on the performance. (4) The man stops dancing and stands still in the bedroom, delivering a final spoken phrase while looking directly at the camera. He lets go of the red envelopes, letting them fall to the floor. A final line of white subtitle text is displayed at the bottom of the frame before the video ends.

(5) [Subtitle]: 所以我做了像這樣的東西. (6) [Subtitle]: Every big street, small alley. 每條大街小巷. (7) [Subtitle]: Every person's mouth inside. 每個人的嘴裡. (8) [Subtitle]: See face, the first sentence says. 見面第一句話.
